_comment: Drop the hooks block below into ~/.cursor/hooks.json (merging with any existing hooks) to reflect Cursor agent sessions into Deckhand. Each hook reads the JSON payload Cursor writes to stdin and forwards it to Deckhand's /agents/cursor/hook endpoint. Replace DECKHAND_URL and DECKHAND_API_KEY with your values (or set them as env vars in your shell profile).

sessionStart.command: jq -c '{session_id, hook_event_name: "sessionStart", cwd: .workspace_roots[0] // .cwd // empty, title: .prompt // empty}' | curl -sS -X POST "${DECKHAND_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}/agents/cursor/hook" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${DECKHAND_API_KEY}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null || true

beforeSubmitPrompt.command: jq -c '{session_id, hook_event_name: "beforeSubmitPrompt", cwd: .workspace_roots[0] // .cwd // empty, title: .prompt // empty}' | curl -sS -X POST "${DECKHAND_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}/agents/cursor/hook" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${DECKHAND_API_KEY}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null || true

preToolUse.command: jq -c '{session_id, hook_event_name: "preToolUse", cwd: .workspace_roots[0] // .cwd // empty}' | curl -sS -X POST "${DECKHAND_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}/agents/cursor/hook" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${DECKHAND_API_KEY}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null || true

postToolUse.command: jq -c '{session_id, hook_event_name: "postToolUse", cwd: .workspace_roots[0] // .cwd // empty}' | curl -sS -X POST "${DECKHAND_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}/agents/cursor/hook" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${DECKHAND_API_KEY}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null || true

postToolUseFailure.command: jq -c '{session_id, hook_event_name: "postToolUseFailure", cwd: .workspace_roots[0] // .cwd // empty}' | curl -sS -X POST "${DECKHAND_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}/agents/cursor/hook" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${DECKHAND_API_KEY}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null || true

stop._comment: On `stop` we set deckhand_status=awaiting_input. Cursor lacks an explicit `agent is waiting for the user` event (unlike Claude Code's `Notification`), so `stop` — the agent finished a turn and the user is now the bottleneck — is the right semantic for the focus_next_pending button to surface this session as needing attention. Edit this override if you want a different mapping.
stop.command: jq -c '{session_id, hook_event_name: "stop", cwd: .workspace_roots[0] // .cwd // empty, deckhand_status: "awaiting_input"}' | curl -sS -X POST "${DECKHAND_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}/agents/cursor/hook" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${DECKHAND_API_KEY}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null || true

sessionEnd.command: jq -c '{session_id, hook_event_name: "sessionEnd"}' | curl -sS -X POST "${DECKHAND_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}/agents/cursor/hook" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${DECKHAND_API_KEY}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null || true
